name: Yard marshalling-kiosk heater control
summary: Identifies the documented conditioning-heater control path in the assigned outdoor kiosk.
description: Identifies the documented conditioning-heater control path in the assigned outdoor kiosk. Yard equipment supervision carries the condition and support-system information of primary equipment into station alarms. A monitor's declared alarm, measurement and self-fault output need separate point names.

In a switchyard marshalling kiosk, gas compartment, operating mechanism and cabinet-service indications are collected for the station controller. Their equipment tags identify the actual compartment or mechanism being monitored. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Kiosk conditioning demand” at the input and “Heater command” at the output. Conditioning settings follow the enclosure design.

Keep primary-device identity, compartment boundaries and monitor health visible. A monitoring illustration does not establish a leak rate, operating threshold or remaining equipment life. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
